brief:
Palestinian Vice President Hussein Al Sheikh has informed France that legislative elections scheduled for November 28 will be delayed by several months due to deteriorating conditions, according to Al-Monitor. The postponement comes amid worsening circumstances across Palestinian territories that have made holding the vote untenable at the planned date.

Details on the specific nature of the conditions prompting the delay were not outlined in the available information.
dek: By John Irish PARIS, Oct 9 (Reuters) - Palestinian Vice President Hussein Al Sheikh has informed France that a Palestinian legislative election planned for November 28 will be postponed, possibly until September 2027, because of worsening conditions…
title: Palestinian leadership postpones November legislative elections
